files.name: dochi_minigames-0.1.1-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.1 Change Log

  • Added a MWENT (Gwent in Minecraft)
  • Added new blocks for minigames.
  • Removed the required dependency on DRM. The mod can now run independently.
  • Improved minigame visuals and effects.
